title: BMP, BGP: Add a "one PDU" BGP dissector, and have BMP use it
description:
The current BGP dissector is for BGP over TCP, and handles
desegmentation. BGP PDUs are also carried in BMP; BMP has a
length indicator and TCP desegmentation is handled by BMP.
BMP contains whole BGP PDUs, guaranteed to be aligned on boundaries.
(But BMP doesn't know where the BGP PDU ends.)

Add a "one BGP PDU" dissector handle, and have BMP use it.
Have dissect_bgp_pdu return the number of bytes dissected, as
BMP needs to that to determine if the Peer Up messages are
followed by optional trailing TLVs.

Use col_append_sep_str so that dissect_bgp_pdu doesn't need to
been passed in a variable telling if it is the first PDU.

Set the length of the proto_bgp item, since BMP might pass it
more bytes than is in a PDU.

Set the Protocol column in dissect_bgp_pdu (also after BGP might
reject the packet.)

Fix #19029. Related to #19004
